record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: For flat or curved Friedmann-Robertson-Walker universes governed by the full first-order corrected string action with the dilaton term and its coupling to higher-order curvature terms included, what are the relevant asymptotic regimes and stability properties, especially for the vacuum solutions of this effective string theory?

evidence.quote:
3.1 Asymptotics of gravi-dilaton ﬂat FRW cosmologies
The plan in this project is to extend relevant asymptotic analysis and stability results ... to the case of the full action (3.1), that is including the dilaton term and its coupling to the higher-order curvature terms. This will provide especially important results for the stability of the vacuum in this eﬀective string theory.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a $(d+1)$-dimensional gravi-dilaton effective string action including first-order $\alpha'$ corrections,
$$S=\frac{1}{2\kappa^2}\int d^{d+1}x\,\sqrt{-g}\,e^{-\phi}\Big[R+(\nabla\phi)^2+\tfrac{\alpha'}{4}\big(R_{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}R^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}+c_1(\nabla\phi)^4+c_2 R(\nabla\phi)^2+\dots\big)\Big],$$
where $\phi$ is the dilaton and the bracketed $\alpha'$ correction includes higher-order curvature terms together with their dilaton couplings (taken in a duality-preserving scheme such as Hohm–Zwiebach). Specialize to a homogeneous, isotropic FRW ansatz
$$ds^2=-dt^2+a(t)^2\,d\Sigma_k^2,\qquad \phi=\phi(t),$$
where $d\Sigma_k^2$ is the spatial metric of constant curvature $k\in\{-1,0,+1\}$, and let $H=\dot a/a$.

Problem. Carry out a complete asymptotic analysis of the resulting autonomous system for $(H,\dot\phi)$ (and its curved-space counterpart for $k\ne0$):
(a) Classify all critical points and asymptotic regimes (early-time and late-time) of the cosmological equations of motion derived from the full $\alpha'$-corrected action including the dilaton terms and their couplings to the higher-curvature terms.
(b) Determine the local and global stability properties of these regimes, in particular establishing the linear and nonlinear stability of the vacuum (trivial flat-space, linear-dilaton) solutions of the effective theory.
(c) Identify whether the inclusion of the $\alpha'$ dilaton couplings alters the attractor structure and the singularity/de Sitter behavior compared to the action without them.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made since 2016: works using the Hohm–Zwiebach O(d,d)-covariant formulation construct non-singular gravi-dilaton FRW solutions to all orders in α′ (Hohm–Zwiebach 2019, JHEP 1909.00830) and provide explicit stability analyses of de Sitter and other fixed points (Krishnan et al., "α′-cosmology: solutions and stability analysis," JHEP 2020, arXiv:2002.09856; Bernardo–Chen–Brandenberger 2308.16076). These cover the flat FRW case at first order in α′ with dilaton couplings included, but a complete classification of all asymptotic regimes and full nonlinear vacuum-stability results, especially for curved (k≠0) FRW, is not fully settled in the literature, so the problem is best regarded as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Non-singular string cosmology via α′ corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs non-singular non-perturbative cosmological solutions with complete α′ corrections in the bosonic gravi-dilaton system.
status_evidence.claim: First-order α′ gravi-dilaton FRW dynamics admit explicit non-singular solutions, partially addressing the asymptotic question.

status_evidence.title: α′-Cosmology: solutions and stability analysis
status_evidence.snippet: O(d,d) covariant string cosmology to all orders in α′; de Sitter solutions in the string frame are not unstable under homogeneous linear perturbations.
status_evidence.claim: Linear stability analysis of α′-corrected gravi-dilaton FRW fixed points has been performed.

status_evidence.title: From the string vacuum to FLRW or de Sitter via α′ corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic transitions from string vacuum to FLRW/de Sitter via α′ corrections analyzed.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotic regimes connecting vacuum and FLRW/de Sitter are studied at α′ order.
